rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns directly with Lisa's work at the intersection of AI and robotics — both are betting on tools and platforms that democratize creation. Charlie's deep experience building developer platforms (Expo, React Native) and his track record scaling communities could offer valuable perspective as Lisa develops Redbey Lakes, especially as she brings enterprise XR and robotics into spaces where accessible tooling matters.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Lisa Wang — you're both focused on how AI expands what builders can create, and Charlie's experience scaling Expo for millions of developers could offer useful perspective on platform strategy for your robotics and XR work.
